program.name: Floor Roulette
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: Longer sessions with no gear and no repeats: bodyweight strength, cardio or core, a new pairing every day.
program.about: No equipment, longer sessions, and no two days alike. Each day deals push-ups, floor pulls, legs, glutes, shoulders, arms, full body, HIIT, jumps, core or balance, in straight sets, supersets, a circuit or an EMOM. Strength days end with a short Tabata or a stretch; the others end with a short bodyweight lift. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Every day different · no equipment, 35–38 minutes
